Package com.egradx.auth.dto

Record Class EgradxUserProfileDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.egradx.auth.dto.EgradxUserProfileDto
Record Components:
displayName - the account's display name — editable here, stored on the account
updatedAt - null if nothing has ever been saved to the profile
public record EgradxUserProfileDto(UUID userId, String username, String email, String displayName, String firstName, String lastName, String jobTitle, String photoUrl, String locale, String timeZone, EgradxPostalAddressDto address, Map<String,Object> attributes, List<EgradxContactDto> contacts, Instant updatedAt) extends Record
A person's profile as a profile screen shows it: who they are (from the account), everything the profile holds, and the contact addresses that apply in the organization it is viewed from.
